text.理论几何读数与演示系数: Theoretical geometry readouts and demonstration coefficients
text.经验偏折与程序生成吸积盘。几何读数采用克尔黑洞理论中的事件视界和顺行赤道光子轨道: Empirical lensing and a procedural accretion disk. Geometry readouts use the event horizon and prograde equatorial photon-orbit formulas of Kerr black hole theory on a normalised scale; other visual coefficients are demonstration settings. [S9]
text.经验偏折与两套程序生成天球的切换；喉部半径和张力是视觉参数，未积分四维测地线。所: Empirical lensing and a switch between two procedural skies; throat radius and tension are visual parameters, not four-dimensional geodesic integration. The so-called fidelity controls colour saturation and does not compute quantum entanglement.
text.常数 w 且暗能量主导时，w 小于 −1/3 对应加速。密度比 rho(a)/r: For constant w with dark energy domination, w below −1/3 corresponds to acceleration. The density ratio rho(a)/rho(1)=a^[−3(1+w)] is mapped to a visual scale at a=2. The Hawking coefficient adjusts the illustrative afterglow; proton decay and rebirth are hypothetical scenarios.
text.不同天体视觉特征的阶段式拼接。质量只缩放示意尺寸；它不会选择真实恒星演化轨迹或确: A staged composite of visual features from different objects. Mass only scales the illustrative size; it does not select a real stellar evolution track or determine the remnant type. Stage readings are demonstration presets.
text.粒子从团聚到弥散的阶段插值和程序化冷热色斑；没有导入 CMB 全天图、角功率谱或: Stage interpolation from clumping to dispersal with procedural warm and cool patches; no CMB all-sky map, angular power spectrum or real galaxy catalogue is imported. Epoch values and time labels are conceptual presets.
text.固定种子的程序节点和纤维；暗物质势、气体滞后与透镜强度控制不同的示意效果，没有求: Fixed-seed procedural nodes and filaments; dark-matter potential, gas lag and lensing strength control different illustrative effects. No gravitational N-body simulation or mass reconstruction is solved.
text.观测表明宇宙膨胀正在加速，但暗能量的基本性质仍有开放问题。[S8]: Observations show that cosmic expansion is accelerating, but the fundamental nature of dark energy remains open. [S8]
text.宇宙微波背景是早期宇宙留下的辐射，ESA 的 Planck 任务对其进行了测量。: The cosmic microwave background is radiation left by the early universe; ESA's Planck mission measured it. [S3]
text.事件视界望远镜研究人马座 A* 与 M87* 附近的辐射结构。[S1]: The Event Horizon Telescope studies the radiation structure near Sagittarius A* and M87*. [S1]
text.子弹星系团的热气体与透镜推断的质量分布发生分离，是研究暗物质的重要观测证据。[S: In the Bullet Cluster, hot gas and lensing-inferred mass are separated, an important observational clue for dark matter. [S4]
text.NGC 3324 的气体空腔受到年轻恒星辐射和恒星风塑造。[S5]: The gas cavities of NGC 3324 are shaped by radiation and winds from young stars. [S5]
text.蟹状星云脉冲星每秒自转约 30 次。[S6]: The Crab pulsar rotates about 30 times per second. [S6]
text.Morris–Thorne 论文讨论了一类可穿越虫洞的几何与物质条件；它是理论模: The Morris–Thorne paper discusses the geometry and matter conditions of a class of traversable wormholes; it is a theoretical model. [S7]
text.英仙座气体压力波的原始频率远低于人耳听阈；NASA 的可听声化经过频率转换。[S: The original frequency of the Perseus gas-pressure waves is far below human hearing; NASA's audible sonification is frequency-shifted. [S2]
text.54、108、162 Hz 振荡器与啁啾声是本项目的合成音效，未导入官方音轨。: The 54, 108 and 162 Hz oscillators and chirps are synthetic effects made for this project; no official audio track is imported.
text.两种低频振荡与穿越扫频是空间氛围音效。: Two low-frequency oscillators and a crossing sweep are spatial atmosphere effects.
text.低音、扫频和重生和弦由振荡器合成。重生动画不代表已观测或必然发生的宇宙事件。: The bass, sweep and rebirth chord are synthesised by oscillators. The rebirth animation does not represent an observed or inevitable cosmic event.
text.振荡器音高随演示纪元下降，属于概念性音效，不是对重子声学振荡数据的重建。: Oscillator pitch falls with the demonstration epoch; this is a conceptual effect, not a reconstruction of baryon acoustic oscillation data.
text.扫描可见程序节点；屏幕横坐标映射扫描时刻和声相，纵坐标映射五声音阶，节点显示强度: Scan visible procedural nodes; horizontal position maps scan time and pan, vertical position maps a pentatonic scale, and node brightness maps loudness.
text.自转频率控制 AudioContext 时间轴上的脉冲间隔；画面将旋转速度放慢以: Spin frequency controls pulse spacing on the AudioContext timeline; the visual rotation is slowed for observation and is not the actual radio waveform.
